whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Second home restaurant and mess,

I noticed your mess and restaurant has solid 4.3★ reviews near Rajendra Nagar railway station in Patna, but lacked a dedicated online menu and direct WhatsApp meal booking page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme daily menu showcase, home delivery booking, aur direct WhatsApp meal inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/secondhome

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Second home restaurant and mess, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (<Business Name>) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with daily menu display, quick home delivery inquiry, and direct WhatsApp orders for customers around Rajendra Nagar railway station. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual daily thali/mess menu aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
